dedupe_keys.name: a point based dataset of rainfall induced shallow landslides in hebei and beijing zixing and longyan china

description: A Point-Based Dataset of Rainfall-Induced Shallow Landslides in Hebei and Beijing, Zixing, and Longyan, China is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Yue Lu et al. Climate change has increased the frequency and intensity of extreme rainfall, driving widespread clusters of landslides. These landslides pose growing risks to lives and infrastructure. Datasets are needed to assess these hazards. Here, we present a point-based dataset of shallow landslide initiation locations triggered by recent rainfall events in China. Coverage: national (CN); published in 2026. The formats are not stated in the sources read. The data are held in Zenodo and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
